title: Worker Adapter Registry
description: Research/data-only registry that INDEXES candidate autonomous coding workers (OpenHands, Aider, SWE-agent, Claude Code, Codex-style) and, for each, the interface it presents (a locally-copied H7 worker-adapter descriptor) PLUS the registry-level lifecycle label, the exact permissions the worker would require, and the founder gates that MUST be cleared before it could ever be installed. This registry is a SPEC INDEX, never runtime: reading, validating, or extending it installs nothing, fetches nothing over the network, holds no credentials, and activates no application runtime. The `lifecycle` field (research | planned | installed) is the anti-fake-state axis: `research` and `planned` entries MUST be status:planned + installed:false, so an un-installed worker can never be presented as live. research != installed.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this registry schema the emitter targeted.

registry_id.description: Stable machine identifier for this registry document.

generated_by.description: The lane/phase that authored this registry (provenance, not an execution grant).

research_only.description: MUST be true. This registry is research/data only; it never crosses into install or runtime.

no_install.description: MUST be true. Building/reading this registry installs no worker.

no_credentials.description: MUST be true. This registry holds no secrets/credentials/tokens for any worker.

no_network_fetch.description: MUST be true. This registry was assembled from documented knowledge, not a live network fetch.

lifecycle_legend.description: Human legend for the lifecycle axis so research/planned/installed are never conflated.

adapters.description: The registry entries. At least the five surveyed candidate workers.

vendor.description: Who publishes the worker (organization/community), for provenance only.

lifecycle.description: research = surveyed only, no descriptor exercised; planned = design-only descriptor sketched, not installed; installed = actually present + in-use in THIS environment. Bound to descriptor.status/installed by the H35 selftest invariants.

one_line.description: One-line summary of what the worker is.

homepage_reference.description: A documentation pointer (project name / repo path as a string). NOT fetched; provenance label only.

license_note.description: Known license family for the worker (research note, verify before any install).

required_permissions.description: The concrete host permissions the worker WOULD require to run (filesystem scope, shell, network egress, model API access, container/sandbox). Declared for review; NOT granted here.

founder_gates_before_install.description: The founder gates that MUST be cleared before this worker could be installed/admitted. At least one; every non-installed worker keeps an 'install' gate here.

install_blockers.description: Why this worker is NOT installed right now (honest blockers). For an installed worker: an empty array is allowed.

descriptor.description: The H7-shape worker-adapter descriptor for this worker, validated against the locally-copied worker-adapter.embedded.schema.json.
